OVER YOUR CHILDREN
end: The Family Altar — cover your home in prayer

scenes.a: Your children are quiet in their beds.
scenes.sub: YOUR CHILDREN ARE IN THEIR BEDS

scenes.a: You wonder what world waits outside their door tomorrow.
Hear the word of the Lord from Isaiah:
scenes.sub: HEAR THE WORD OF THE LORD

scenes.a: Behold, I and the children whom the LORD hath given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the LORD of hosts, which dwelleth in mount Zion.
Heavenly Father, cover our household tonight with Your peace.
scenes.sub: COVER OUR HOME WITH YOUR PEACE

scenes.a: Set our children apart as living signs of Your grace and holy truth.
scenes.sub: SET APART FOR GRACE AND TRUTH

scenes.a: Where the world brings uncertainty, anchor their young hearts firmly in Your love.
scenes.sub: ANCHOR THEM FIRMLY IN YOUR LOVE

scenes.a: Shield their lives from harm and guide every step they take.
Amen. Rest now, for your children are quiet in their beds.
scenes.sub: YOUR HOUSEHOLD IS IN HIS HANDS

Hear the word of the Lord from Isaiah:
Behold, I and the children whom the LORD hath given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the LORD of hosts, which dwelleth in mount Zion.

Set our children apart as living signs of Your grace and holy truth.
Where the world brings uncertainty, anchor their young hearts firmly in Your love.

Amen. Rest now, for your children are quiet in their beds.
